name: id
description: Membership-period identifier: one row per member per month, the move observed between consecutive monthly snapshots

name: from_tier
description: Loyalty tier at the start of the month: bronze, silver, gold or churned (churned members stay churned)

name: to_tier
description: Loyalty tier at the end of the same month, on the same four states as from_tier, so the pair forms a square transition table
